pr_title: Fix map-player bots not working on dedicated servers.
pr_comments: A simple testcase is to cherry-pick this onto `release-20210321` and then start a game using https://resource.openra.net/maps/42849/ on one of the public dedicated servers. Only the host needs to have the fix for it to work for all players.

issue_context.title: Creeps and Neutrals do nothing on Dedicated Servers
issue_context.body:
## Issue Summary
When creating Custom Maps, Neutrals and Creeps that are assigned AI or bot behavior, such as rushai, do nothing when a game is running from a Dedicated Server. When playing locally in single player, or hosting a multiplayer game from a computer that is actually being used to play the game, the Neutrals and Creeps act as their assigned AI or bot behavior.

I have only tried this in the RA mod, I have not tried TD or D2k. The map is here: https://resource.openra.net/maps/42849/

I have noticed this as far back as release-20191117, which is when I  initially created the map.

review_comments: Can/should we even fix that this player is owned by the host?

That question opens a can of worms, since "the host" hasn't even existed as a concept for many years. If you're playing a game on a dedicated server that has two or more clients with `IsAdmin` set (the frontend UI prevents this, but #17659 would change that) then who should own this?

#17659 simply re-using the `IsAdmin` flag doesn't sound like a good idea to me (otherwise this line needs to change again?). It would likely be better to have a new flag for that, or rather split into `(In)GameAdmin` and `LobbyAdmin`/`ServerAdmin`.
Maybe. But then there's also the (good) idea to spread bot control over multiple clients to reduce performance overheads.
